g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
Checklist for removing personal information before
uploading documents to AI: checking with a hypothetical
contract example
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-10-21
Divide the information in the file
into four categories before uploading
(1) Identifying information: names, contact
details, addresses, part of a resident
registration number (2) Financial information…
Check training-use settings: ChatGPT
and Gemini examples
According to OpenAI Help, turning off 'Improve
the model for everyone' under ChatGPT's Settings
> Data controls means that new conversations…
Hypothetical example: Items to redact
in a proposal draft
The following is a hypothetical situation
created for explanation and is not an actual
company or contract.
Post-upload checklist
① Check whether the redacted numbers or names
reappear in the summary. ② Decide whether to
retain the conversation history, and delete it…
